summary: The change correctly invalidates in-flight provider roster loads whenever the picker selection is edited, preventing stale server selections from overwriting local changes.

evidence: The new edit marker increments providerSelectionLoadId for checkbox edits, bulk selection changes, missing-entry removal, and discard actions.
loadProviderSelection checks the request token before applying the server selection, so a response completing after an edit is ignored.
A focused regression test verifies the stale-load guard and marker coverage across provider picker handlers.
